errors.text_span: der rechte Balken in Dunkelviolettt mit diagonalen Streifen steht für „60 % des Medianlohns der Vollzeitbeschäftigten“
errors.evidence: This incorrectly generalizes the striped pattern to all purple bars. In the chart, only the purple bars for the years 2024 and 2025 have diagonal stripes; the others are solid.

errors.text_span: es gibt keine visuelle Hervorhebung bestimmter Balken
errors.evidence: This statement is factually incorrect. The purple bars for 2024 and 2025 are visually highlighted with a striped pattern to distinguish them from the solid bars of previous years, which likely indicates they are projected or estimated values.
